Hey [PERSON_NAME_0040], PlayableX is looking for these assets to build the ZM3D playable. Can I ask who the best person would be to grant them access?
• *3D assets*: .fbx, .glb, or .blend (when exporting .fbx, please make sure it’s exported in *Binary format*, not ASCII)
• *2D assets*: .png (for 2D animations, character parts need to be separated into pieces)
• *Font*: .ttf or .woff2
• *Sound*: .mp3 or .wav
Hey, [PERSON_NAME_0036]. [PERSON_NAME_0092] fished out the assets for the Domino playable before so I think he's your guy.
I would also ask Marcus if you're going to use 2D zombie animations because he'd made them with bones.
Last time we didn't give them access, we just put what they needed in a zip file and sent it over.
